items.title: Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2022
items.q: we played it in a hall that was named after Karen Carpenter, or Richard Carpenter or something.

ctx.x: No, they’re not worth a fortune but they’re worth something.

Well I know I played a gig with the Los Angeles Jazz Orchestra and we played it in a hall that was named after Karen Carpenter, or Richard Carpenter or something. And when I went out to the lobby to sign autographs and stuff they had, in a glass case, this thing about the Carpenters. And there was one of those small Baldwin amps, like the kind we © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-

had. I mean the reason we had Baldwin was Dave was a Baldwin piano artist and he said, “Hey your kids play rock & roll and stuff,” you know, “do you think they would like some amps?” And actually we had them for a while. And actually you know who’s got the Exterminator is my son-in-law, who is a carpenter and a drummer. And he’s got the Exterminator set up so he can play back CDs so he can bang along with it with Primus or some of these other groups.
